title: Tests.
officialText:
Drain, waste and vent piping for water recycling systems shall be tested in accordance with Section PC 312.
Distribution piping for water recycling systems shall be tested in accordance with Section 312.5. Additional tests shall be
performed in accordance with Sections C103.12.1 and C103.12.2.
